name: bottoms-up-1-kettlebell-split-squat
instructions:
1. Set up in a split stance with a kettlebell in the opposite hand as the forward leg.
2. Position the kettlebell in a bottoms up position and keep the elbow in line with the shoulder.
3. Descend by flexing both knees simultaneously and continue until the back knee touches the ground directly beneath the hip.
4. Drive through the front foot and extend the knee as you return to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
